This script imports ACS variables for tract-level analysis.

## Define helper functions

```{r}
#' Calculate aggregate rent cat from ACS estimates
#'
#' @param start ACS starting rent category
#' @param end ACS ending rent category
#' @return agg rent cat count
#' @details agg_rent_Cat = sum(start, start+1, ... end)
rent_cat_sum <- function(start, end) {
  rowSums(across(any_of(paste0("grentcat", start:end, "E"))), na.rm = TRUE)
}


#' Summary statistics for a single ACS estimate included in a dataframe
#'
#' @param df Data frame
#' @param var_name ACS estimate name
#' @return Summary statistics
summ_var <- function(df, var_name) {
  moe_name <- sub("E$", "M", var_name)
  cv_name <- sub("E$", "CV", var_name)
  summarise(
    df,
    var        = var_name,
    n          = sum(!is.na(.data[[var_name]])),
    n_missing  = sum(is.na(.data[[var_name]])),
    mean       = mean(.data[[var_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
    min        = min(.data[[var_name]],  na.rm = TRUE),
    max        = max(.data[[var_name]],  na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_error = if (moe_name %in% names(df)) mean(.data[[moe_name]], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    mean_cv    = if (cv_name %in% names(df)) mean(.data[[cv_name]], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_, 
    p75_cv     = if (cv_name %in% names(df)) quantile(.data[[cv_name]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    p90_cv     = if (cv_name %in% names(df)) quantile(.data[[cv_name]], 0.9, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
  )
}


#' Rename ID
#'
#' @param df Data frame
#' @param new_name 
#' @param old_name 
#' @return Data frame with renamed ID variable and dummy ID
rename_id <- function(df, new_name, old_name) {
  df <- df |>
    rename({{new_name}} := {{old_name}}) |>
    mutate(rent_id = TRUE)
}


#' Save data
#'
#' @param df Data frame
#' @param dir Directory
#' @param name 
#' @return Data frame with renamed ID variable and dummy ID
save_data <- function(df, dir, name) {
    df |>
        arrow::write_feather(paste0(dir,name))
}



```

# Data Import and Preparation

## Bring in 2012-2016 ACS Tract Variables

```{r }

# Load ACS tables
acs_trt_16 <- get_acs(geography = "tract",
                       state = "CA",
                       variables = v16_save,
                       year = 2016,
                       output = "wide",
                       survey = "acs5")


# Calculate low rent housing units
acs_trt_16 <- acs_trt_16 |>
  mutate(
         rhu_lrE = rent_cat_sum(1,17),
         rhu_lr2E = rent_cat_sum(1,19)

         )


# Check missing data + margin of error
vars <- c("popE", "rentE")

out <- map_dfr(vars, ~summ_var(acs_trt_16, .x))
out

# Rename ID 
acs_trt_16 <- rename_id(acs_trt_16, tr2010_id, GEOID)

# Save file
save_data(acs_trt_16, data_dir, "acs_step1_16.feather")

rm(v16, v16_save)
```

# Crosswalk Import and Preparation

## Bring in crosswalk: 2023 block group to 2010 tracts

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
xwalk <- read_csv("/Users/jschirmer/Documents/ADU/data-raw-temp/nhgis/nhgis_bg2020_tr2010_06/nhgis_bg2020_tr2010_06.csv") |>
  mutate(x_id = TRUE) 

# Check missing data

xwalk|>
  summarise(
    across(c(wt_pop, wt_hh), list(
      n = ~sum(!is.na(.)),
      pct_missing = ~100 * sum(is.na(.)) / n(),
      mean = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
      min = ~min(., na.rm = TRUE),
      max = ~max(., na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .names = "{.col}_{.fn}")
  ) 

xwalk|>
  summarise(
    across(c(wt_hu, wt_renthu), list(
      n = ~sum(!is.na(.)),
      pct_missing = ~100 * sum(is.na(.)) / n(),
      mean = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
      min = ~min(., na.rm = TRUE),
      max = ~max(., na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .names = "{.col}_{.fn}")
  ) 

# Check duplicates
length(unique(xwalk$bg2020ge)) ## 25617
length(unique(rent_bg_23$bg2020_id)) ## 25607

# Rename variables
xwalk <- xwalk |>
  rename(bg2020_id = bg2020ge,
         tr2010_id = tr2010ge) |>
  select(c(bg2020_id, tr2010_id, wt_pop, wt_hh, wt_hu, wt_renthu, x_id))

# Save file
xwalk %>% 
  arrow::write_feather(paste0(data_dir, "xwalk_bg23_tr10.feather"))

rm(xwalk)

```
